page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, printed page number at the top right. No marginal notes. Signature at the foot right. Woodcut ornament between the first paragraph and the chapter heading, not transcribed.

main_text.p: Valentinum sapere viderentur: ita bonis discipulis male cum suo præceptore Valentino conueniet. 3 Error, negant Christum vere incar-natum, & hominem factum esse.
main_text.head: CAP. XIII. Ptolemiani quid à Valentinianis differant.

p.i: Tolemæus{1} quoque discipulus Valentini, hæresin nouam condere cupiens, quatuor{2} Æonas, & alios quatuor afferre maluit.

main_text.p: 1 Ptolemæus.) Fere hæc hæresis prætermittitur, uti à Clemente, Theodoreto, Eusebio, & Isidoro, quia cum superiori consentit. Tertullianus Ptolemæum & Secundum coniunxit. Alii tamen, uti hic Augustinus & Epiphanius, seorsim separant. Ptolemæum tamen in schola successis-se Secundo tradit apertè Epiphanius. alij cum ex Marci, cuius hæresis sequenti capite explicabitur, præstigiis extitisse malunt. Certè fuerunt hi omnes fermè contemporanei, quemadmodum antea diximus. Viuebat tamen adhuc Irenæi ætate (qui tamen Valentino ipso posterior fuit) hic Ptolemæus & in Occidentis partibus notior videtur fuisse, uti Secundus in Oriente. Id quod ex ipso lib.i.proœmio aduersus Valentinum facilè colligetur. Vsus autem est ad sua dogmata propaganda Ptolemæus Flora quadā fœmina ad quam longa epistola scripsit suam sententiam, & quam sororem suam appellat.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament between the opening paragraph and the chapter heading not transcribed. Opening words set in a large decorative initial T; read as "Tolemæus". Reference marks 1 and 2 in the opening passage are as printed. "Alij" read as "Alii" (vowel i). Hyphenated line-break word "successis-se" is a doubtful reading (scan shows "fucceffif-" / "fe"). Printed "Ifidoro" read as "Isidoro"; printed "Eufebio" read as "Eusebio". No notes printed in margins.
